content.title: An $800 Billion Revenue Shortfall Threatens AI Future, Bain Says
content.summary: OpenAI is losing billions of dollars a year and prioritizing growth over profit, but it does expect to be cash-flow positive by 2029, Bloomberg has reported.  The biggest tech firms including Microsoft Corp., Amazon.com Inc. and Meta Platforms Inc. will ramp up their combined annual spending on AI to more than $500 billion by early next decade, according to Bloomberg Intelligence.
